## Discoveries

[The Crooked Tower's Roof](../world/discoveries.md#the-crooked-tower-roof), [The Walkers' Pictures](../world/discoveries.md#the-walkers-pictures), [The Halfway Stone](../world/discoveries.md#the-halfway-stone), [The Old Cart Track](../world/discoveries.md#the-old-cart-track), [The Last Beacon](../world/discoveries.md#the-last-beacon)

Regional mastery, earned by making discoveries here:

- **Street Sense** (2 discoveries): 600 mesos
- **Old Grad Native** (4 discoveries): 1,500 mesos

A taxi from [Gate Walk Carter](../npcs/urbanograd_carter.md) takes you to any other town for 150 mesos.
